systems.name: Order Service
systems.description: Accepts orders and looks up customer records in CRM.

systems.name: Billing Worker
systems.description: Consumes order events, creates ERP invoices, and receives payment status updates.

systems.name: External CRM
systems.description: Fictional external customer system; also exports customers directly to ERP.

systems.name: External ERP
systems.description: Fictional external finance system for invoices, payments, and customer master data.

interfaces.name: Order placed event
interfaces.interaction: Publish order.placed to the billing queue
interfaces.summary: Triggers invoice creation after an order is accepted.
interfaces.authentication: Broker service identity with publish/consume permissions.
interfaces.reliability: At-least-once delivery; deduplicate by eventId. Retry transient failures, then route to a dead-letter queue.
notes: The arrow follows event flow from publisher to subscriber.

interfaces.name: Customer lookup
interfaces.summary: Resolves a customer record while accepting an order.
interfaces.reliability: 3-second timeout; retry 429 and transient 5xx with bounded backoff. Do not retry 404.
notes: The arrow follows the HTTP request; the response travels back on the same connection.
The deployed contract version is 1.4.0; /v1 is only the API major-version route.

interfaces.name: Create invoice
interfaces.summary: Creates one invoice for an accepted order.
interfaces.reliability: Send Idempotency-Key equal to orderId; retry transient errors using the same key.
notes: Payment updates arrive separately via IF-004.

interfaces.name: Payment status webhook
interfaces.summary: Notifies the Billing Worker when an invoice payment status changes.
interfaces.authentication: Verify the vendor HMAC signature and reject timestamps outside the replay window.
interfaces.reliability: Return 2xx after durable enqueue; deduplicate by eventId. Vendor retries non-2xx responses.
notes: The arrow follows the inbound webhook request from external ERP.
A JSON Schema defines the payload; this page documents transport and operational behavior.

interfaces.name: Nightly customer export
interfaces.summary: Transfers customer master data directly between the two external systems.
interfaces.authentication: Vendor-managed SFTP key; the internal platform does not hold credentials.
interfaces.reliability: Upload to a temporary name, then rename atomically; ERP acknowledges with a .done file. Alert on a missing daily delivery.
notes: This connection bypasses internal components but remains part of the integration landscape.
Customer Operations owns coordination between the two vendors.
